tasks.gr7-poetry-prescribed-text-work-t2: Topic: Poetry and prescribed text work. Cover stanza, rhyme, imagery, tone, and line-reference interpretation while connecting poetry ideas to prescribed texts. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify techniques, explain tone, and choose evidence-based responses to contextual questions.
tasks.gr7-formal-functional-writing-t2: Topic: Formal and functional writing. Cover formal letters, emails, dialogue, descriptive essays, and register. Ask Grade 7 learners to match text type to purpose and audience, recognise layout conventions, and select language appropriate for formal communication.
tasks.gr7-grammar-cohesion-t2: Topic: Grammar for cohesion. Cover adjectives, adverbs, conjunctions, and sentence links that improve flow. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose accurate modifiers, join ideas logically, and identify edits that strengthen coherence in short passages.
